name: Ali Fathieh
headline: Software engineer building calm, careful tools for people who do serious work.
about: I design and build web products end to end — from the data model up to the last hairline border. Most of my time goes into interfaces that people live in all day, where small frictions compound and taste is a feature. Previously in fintech and practice management; currently interested in local-first software, editorial layout on the web, and making things that stay fast for years.

projects.title: teleprompter
projects.description: A local, single-page teleprompter in React and TypeScript. Scripts and settings stay in your browser: no backend, no accounts, no telemetry.

projects.title: golinks
projects.description: A self-hosted link shortener with click analytics and QR codes on Cloudflare Workers. KV holds the slugs, D1 holds the click log.

projects.title: zcal
projects.description: A private, single-user scheduling tool: read one calendar, publish free time, let someone reserve a slot, and write the meeting back.

projects.title: qrforge
projects.description: A self-hosted QR code generator with dynamic, editable codes and scan tracking. One Node process, one SQLite file.
